Feature release adding usage limit reset tracking and credit balance notifications.

## Highlights

- Added available usage limit resets beneath credits, with an independent control for showing or hiding the meter.
- Added low-credit notifications with configurable thresholds of 250, 100, 50, 25, or 10 credits.
- Added credit addition notifications and separate controls for notifications when usage limit reset counts decrease or increase.
- Included the remaining balance or reset count in each notification. Reset decreases are described as used or expired because the usage endpoint does not distinguish between them.
- Improved notification baselines and duplicate suppression so enabling alerts preserves the first subsequent credit or reset change.
- Preserved existing saved meter preferences and refined Settings sections and menu spacing for credits and resets.
- Formatted numeric credit balances as whole credits throughout the app and menu bar.
- Restored the usage dashboard shortcut to the updated usage overview page.
- Expanded test coverage for reset counts, credit formatting, preference compatibility, and notification behavior.
